quests.question: If she had studied economics at university,
options: she would be working in finance now.
she would have worked in finance.
she will work in finance now.
quests.correctAnswer: she works in finance now.
quests.hint: Past perfect if-clause + present result - classic mixed conditional (3rd+2nd).
quests.explanation: Mixed conditional: If + past perfect (unreal past choice) → would + be (present consequence). She didn't study economics (past perfect = imaginary past). If she had (imaginary), she would be working in finance NOW (would + infinitive - present job). Key distinction: 'would have worked' (3rd conditional) gives a past result; 'would be working' gives a PRESENT result.

If it had been better (imaginary), the harvest might have been larger (might have + past participle). 'Might have' rather than 'would have' acknowledges that even good weather doesn't guarantee a large harvest - other factors matter.
